case.summary: Verdict: uncertain. Card C13171-K2 (customer C13171) shows 17 online transactions totaling $816.09 between 2016-12-18 and 2016-12-21, with several small authorizations (e.g., txn 3553275 at $9.51, 3554589 at $11.91, 3555638 at $11.85, 3556719 at $8.33) followed by larger purchases (e.g., 3561532 at $126.47), and multiple transactions flagged with device id_15='New' — a possible card-not-present/new-device pattern, though the heuristic gives only 0.28 fraud probability with a single signal. The card has three prior confirmed-fraud cases (CC-1715, CC-3422, CC-3566, CC-0056, CC-5010), which raises concern but does not confirm this window. Recommended action: VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER and MONITOR_CARD per R1, escalating to an analyst if the customer denies the activity.
